terminals.name: craft-server
terminals.description: Headless Craft Agents server (RPC over WebSocket on 127.0.0.1:9100). A fresh dev bearer token is generated on each boot and printed as CRAFT_SERVER_TOKEN; use it with the CLI: `bun run apps/cli/src/index.ts --url ws://127.0.0.1:9100 --token <token> ping`.
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; export CRAFT_BUNDLED_ASSETS_ROOT="$PWD/apps/electron"; export CRAFT_RPC_HOST=127.0.0.1; export CRAFT_RPC_PORT=9100; export CRAFT_SERVER_TOKEN="dev-$(openssl rand -hex 24)"; echo "CRAFT_SERVER_TOKEN=$CRAFT_SERVER_TOKEN"; exec bun run packages/server/src/index.ts
